plugins.name: lindo-ai
plugins.description: Create websites, pages, and blog posts with AI. Manage clients, credits, and domains — all through conversation.

skills.name: create-blog
skills.description: Creates a blog post on a website using AI. Use when the user wants to write, publish, or generate a blog post or article.
skills.description_zh: 使用AI在网站创建博客文章，支持撰写、生成及发布。

skills.name: create-website
skills.description: Creates a new website using AI. Use when the user wants to build, create, or spin up a website, landing page, or online presence for a business.
skills.description_zh: 使用AI为业务创建网站、落地页或线上展示。

skills.name: edit-website
skills.description: Edits an existing website (across its pages) using AI. Use when the user wants to change copy, layout, styling, or content on a website they already have.
skills.description_zh: 使用AI跨页面修改既有网站的文案、布局、样式和内容。

skills.name: manage-clients
skills.description: Manages workspace clients — create, list, update, delete clients, assign websites, generate login links, and allocate credits. Use when the user wants to manage their agency clients.
skills.description_zh: 管理工作区代理机构客户，创建查询更新删除客户、分配网站、生成登录链接及分配额度。

skills.name: manage-content
skills.description: Manages pages and blog posts — list, view, publish, update, unpublish, and delete content on websites. Use when the user wants to manage existing pages or blog posts.
skills.description_zh: 管理网站既有页面及博客，列举查看发布更新撤下或删除内容。

skills.name: manage-websites
skills.description: Manages websites — list, view details, update settings, manage domains, and check analytics. Use when the user wants to view or configure their existing websites.
skills.description_zh: 查询配置既有网站，查看详情、调整设置、管理域名和分析数据。

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Show a summary dashboard of your Lindo AI workspace — websites, clients, and usage at a glance.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check the status of your recent website builds and content generation.
